days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: Hello, and thank you for meeting me. I would propose 84 P with delivery on day 0.
I appreciate it, thank you. Could we close at 94 P, delivery on day 0, please?
Fair enough, thank you. I will meet you partway: 99 P with delivery on day 0.
Thank you, we are getting close. 102 P and delivery on day 0 works for me.
Last word from me: 87 P, delivery day 10.
